f.title: Identify and declare important data; no declaration needed if not notified as important data
f.statement: Data handlers shall identify and declare important data in accordance with the relevant rules. Data that has not been notified by the relevant departments or regions, or publicly released, as important data does not need to be declared for a cross-border data security assessment as important data.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad.

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者), e.g. MAH, sponsor or PV service provider
rows.quote: 第二条 数据处理者应当按照相关规定识别、申报重要数据。未被相关部门、地区告知或者公开发布为重要数据的，数据处理者不需要作为重要数据申报数据出境安全评估。
rows.review_note: Review: statement follows Art. 2 (应当 = shall). Translation check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: level Mandatory follows 应当; the relief in the second sentence stays in the statement as part of the same duty.
rows.quote_en: Article 2 Data handlers shall identify and declare important data in accordance with the relevant provisions. Where data has not been notified by the relevant departments or regions, or publicly released, as important data, the data handler does not need to declare it as important data for a cross-border data security assessment.

f.title: Exemption: outbound data from trade, academic cooperation or manufacturing with no personal information or important data
f.statement: Data collected and generated in international trade, cross-border transport, academic cooperation, transnational production and manufacturing, marketing and similar activities that is provided abroad is exempt from the cross-border data security assessment, the standard contract and personal information protection certification, provided it contains no personal information or important data.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad. Fully anonymised or aggregate safety data only; ICSRs contain personal information.
f.exceptions: Not available when the data contain personal information or important data.

rows.quote: 第三条 国际贸易、跨境运输、学术合作、跨国生产制造和市场营销等活动中收集和产生的数据向境外提供，不包含个人信息或者重要数据的，免予申报数据出境安全评估、订立个人信息出境标准合同、通过个人信息保护认证。
rows.review_note: Review: exemption, level Permitted (免予). Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: PV case data normally contain personal information, so this exemption seldom covers ICSR transfers (only fully anonymised aggregate data); held below 90 because the PV relevance rests on that reading.
rows.quote_en: Article 3 Where data collected and generated in activities such as international trade, cross-border transport, academic cooperation, transnational production and manufacturing and marketing are provided abroad and do not contain personal information or important data, they are exempt from declaring a cross-border data security assessment, concluding a standard contract for outbound personal information and passing personal information protection certification.

f.title: Exemption: personal information collected abroad, processed in China and sent back abroad
f.statement: Where a data handler transfers abroad personal information that was collected and generated outside China, transmitted into China for processing, and no domestic personal information or important data was introduced during the processing, the transfer is exempt from the security assessment, the standard contract and certification.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad. Relevant to case processing of foreign (non-China) cases in China.
f.exceptions: Does not apply if domestic personal information or important data is introduced during processing.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者), e.g. a PV service provider in China processing foreign ICSRs
rows.quote: 第四条 数据处理者在境外收集和产生的个人信息传输至境内处理后向境外提供，处理过程中没有引入境内个人信息或者重要数据的，免予申报数据出境安全评估、订立个人信息出境标准合同、通过个人信息保护认证。
rows.review_note: Review: exemption (免予), level Permitted. Translation check: re-translation agrees in meaning. Double-check: statement says nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 4 Where personal information collected and generated abroad by a data handler is transmitted into China for processing and then provided abroad, and no domestic personal information or important data is introduced in the processing, it is exempt from declaring a cross-border data security assessment, concluding a standard contract for outbound personal information and passing personal information protection certification.

f.title: Exemptions for outbound personal information: contracts, HR, emergencies to protect life and health, under 100,000 persons
f.statement: A data handler providing personal information abroad is exempt from the security assessment, the standard contract and certification where any one of these applies: (1) it is truly necessary to conclude or perform a contract to which the individual is a party; (2) it is truly necessary for cross-border human-resources management of employees under lawful labour rules and collective contracts; (3) in an emergency it is truly necessary to protect the life, health and property of a natural person; (4) a data handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator has, since 1 January of the current year, provided abroad personal information of fewer than 100,000 persons in total (not including sensitive personal information). Personal information provided abroad under this article does not include important data.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad.
f.exceptions: The 100,000-person threshold excludes sensitive personal information and is not available to critical information infrastructure operators; important data is never covered.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote:
第五条 数据处理者向境外提供个人信息，符合下列条件之一的，免予申报数据出境安全评估、订立个人信息出境标准合同、通过个人信息保护认证：
 （一）为订立、履行个人作为一方当事人的合同，如跨境购物、跨境寄递、跨境汇款、跨境支付、跨境开户、机票酒店预订、签证办理、考试服务等，确需向境外提供个人信息的；
 （二）按照依法制定的劳动规章制度和依法签订的集体合同实施跨境人力资源管理，确需向境外提供员工个人信息的；
 （三）紧急情况下为保护自然人的生命健康和财产安全，确需向境外提供个人信息的；
 （四）关键信息基础设施运营者以外的数据处理者自当年1月1日起累计向境外提供不满10万人个人信息（不含敏感个人信息）的。
 前款所称向境外提供的个人信息，不包括重要数据。
rows.review_note: Review: exemptions (免予), level Permitted. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: for PV, the volume exemption (4) excludes sensitive personal information (health data in ICSRs), so routine ICSR transfers usually fall under Art. 7 or 8; item (3) covers only emergencies. Held below 90 because applicability to PV rests on that reading.
rows.quote_en: Article 5 Where a data handler provides personal information abroad and meets any one of the following conditions, it is exempt from declaring a cross-border data security assessment, concluding a standard contract for outbound personal information and passing personal information protection certification: (1) it is truly necessary to provide personal information abroad to conclude or perform a contract to which the individual is a party, such as cross-border shopping, cross-border mailing, cross-border remittance, cross-border payment, cross-border account opening, air ticket and hotel booking, visa processing and examination services; (2) it is truly necessary to provide employees' personal information abroad to carry out cross-border human resources management in accordance with labour rules and regulations formulated according to law and collective contracts concluded according to law; (3) it is truly necessary to provide personal information abroad in an emergency to protect the life, health and property safety of a natural person; (4) a data handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator has, since 1 January of the current year, cumulatively provided abroad personal information of fewer than 100,000 persons (not including sensitive personal information). The personal information provided abroad referred to in the preceding paragraph does not include important data.

f.title: Free trade zone negative list: data outside the list may be exempt
f.statement: Data handlers located in a pilot free trade zone may be exempt from the security assessment, the standard contract and certification when providing abroad data that is not on the zone's negative list (the list of data the zone has brought under those regimes, approved by the provincial cyberspace commission and filed with the national authorities).
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad. Only companies registered in a pilot free trade zone.

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者) in a pilot free trade zone
rows.quote: 自由贸易试验区内数据处理者向境外提供负面清单外的数据，可以免予申报数据出境安全评估、订立个人信息出境标准合同、通过个人信息保护认证。
rows.review_note: Review: 可以免予 = may be exempt, level Permitted. The first paragraph (zones draw up and file the negative list) is an authority task and is not a row; it is only paraphrased in the statement in brackets. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: held below 90 because the bracketed list description comes from paragraph 1, not from the quote.
rows.quote_en: Data handlers within a pilot free trade zone that provide abroad data outside the negative list may be exempt from declaring a cross-border data security assessment, concluding a standard contract for outbound personal information and passing personal information protection certification.

f.title: Declare a cross-border data security assessment above the thresholds (incl. 10,000 persons of sensitive personal information)
f.statement: A data handler providing data abroad shall declare a cross-border data security assessment to the national cyberspace authority through the provincial cyberspace authority where it is located when any one of these applies: (1) a critical information infrastructure operator provides personal information or important data abroad; (2) a data handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator provides important data abroad, or has, since 1 January of the current year, provided abroad personal information of 1,000,000 or more persons (not including sensitive personal information) or sensitive personal information of 10,000 or more persons in total. The exemptions of Articles 3 to 6 prevail.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad.
f.exceptions: Situations under Articles 3, 4, 5 and 6 follow those articles.

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者), e.g. MAH or sponsor transferring safety data abroad
rows.quote:
第七条 数据处理者向境外提供数据，符合下列条件之一的，应当通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门申报数据出境安全评估：
 （一）关键信息基础设施运营者向境外提供个人信息或者重要数据；
 （二）关键信息基础设施运营者以外的数据处理者向境外提供重要数据，或者自当年1月1日起累计向境外提供100万人以上个人信息（不含敏感个人信息）或者1万人以上敏感个人信息。
 属于本规定第三条、第四条、第五条、第六条规定情形的，从其规定。
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 = shall, level Mandatory; thresholds and the Articles 3-6 carve-out kept. Translation check: re-translation agrees in numbers and modal force. Double-check: ICSR health data are sensitive personal information, so the 10,000-person threshold is the one PV transfers usually meet.
rows.quote_en: Article 7 Where a data handler provides data abroad and meets any one of the following conditions, it shall declare a cross-border data security assessment to the national cyberspace authority through the provincial cyberspace authority where it is located: (1) a critical information infrastructure operator provides personal information or important data abroad; (2) a data handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator provides important data abroad, or has, since 1 January of the current year, cumulatively provided abroad personal information of 1,000,000 or more persons (not including sensitive personal information) or sensitive personal information of 10,000 or more persons. Situations falling under Articles 3, 4, 5 and 6 of these Provisions follow those provisions.

f.title: Conclude the standard contract or obtain certification for mid-volume transfers (incl. under 10,000 persons of sensitive PI)
f.statement: A data handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator that has, since 1 January of the current year, provided abroad personal information of 100,000 or more but fewer than 1,000,000 persons (not including sensitive personal information), or sensitive personal information of fewer than 10,000 persons, shall in accordance with law conclude a standard contract for outbound personal information with the overseas recipient or pass personal information protection certification. The exemptions of Articles 3 to 6 prevail.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad.
f.exceptions: Situations under Articles 3, 4, 5 and 6 follow those articles.
f.systems: standard contract for outbound personal information
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者), e.g. MAH or sponsor transferring safety data abroad
rows.quote:
第八条 关键信息基础设施运营者以外的数据处理者自当年1月1日起累计向境外提供10万人以上、不满100万人个人信息（不含敏感个人信息）或者不满1万人敏感个人信息的，应当依法与境外接收方订立个人信息出境标准合同或者通过个人信息保护认证。
 属于本规定第三条、第四条、第五条、第六条规定情形的，从其规定。
systems: standard contract for outbound personal information
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 = shall, level Mandatory; thresholds kept. Translation check: re-translation agrees in numbers and modal force. Double-check: any transfer of sensitive personal information below 10,000 persons not covered by Arts. 3-6 needs the standard contract or certification.
rows.quote_en: Article 8 A data handler other than a critical information infrastructure operator that has, since 1 January of the current year, cumulatively provided abroad personal information of 100,000 or more but fewer than 1,000,000 persons (not including sensitive personal information), or sensitive personal information of fewer than 10,000 persons, shall in accordance with law conclude a standard contract for outbound personal information with the overseas recipient or pass personal information protection certification. Situations falling under Articles 3, 4, 5 and 6 of these Provisions follow those provisions.

f.title: Apply to extend a security assessment result within 60 working days before its 3-year expiry
f.statement: A passed cross-border data security assessment is valid for 3 years from the date the result is issued. Where cross-border transfer needs to continue on expiry and nothing has occurred that requires a new declaration, the data handler may, within 60 working days before expiry, apply through the provincial cyberspace authority to the national cyberspace authority to extend the validity; with approval the validity may be extended by 3 years.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad.
f.exceptions: Not available where a situation requiring a new security assessment declaration has occurred.

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者) holding a security assessment result
rows.deadline: Within 60 working days before the 3-year validity of the assessment result expires
rows.quote: 第九条 通过数据出境安全评估的结果有效期为3年，自评估结果出具之日起计算。有效期届满，需要继续开展数据出境活动且未发生需要重新申报数据出境安全评估情形的，数据处理者可以在有效期届满前60个工作日内通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门提出延长评估结果有效期申请。经国家网信部门批准，可以延长评估结果有效期3年。
rows.review_note: Review: 可以 = may, level Permitted; 3-year validity and 60-working-day window kept. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: the 60 working days is a window before expiry, not a period after an event, so no deadline_rule is set; held below 90 for that reason only.
rows.quote_en: Article 9 The result of a passed cross-border data security assessment is valid for 3 years, counted from the date the assessment result is issued. Where, on expiry, cross-border data activities need to continue and no situation requiring a new declaration of a cross-border data security assessment has occurred, the data handler may, within 60 working days before expiry, apply through the provincial cyberspace authority where it is located to the national cyberspace authority to extend the validity of the assessment result. With the approval of the national cyberspace authority, the validity of the assessment result may be extended by 3 years.

f.title: Give notice, obtain separate consent and carry out a PI protection impact assessment before outbound transfer
f.statement: A data handler providing personal information abroad shall fulfil the obligations laid down by laws and administrative regulations, such as informing individuals, obtaining the individual's separate consent and carrying out a personal information protection impact assessment.
f.topic: Cross-border data transfer: notice, consent, impact assessment
f.legal_basis: Laws and administrative regulations (e.g. Personal Information Protection Law)
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad. Applies whether or not the transfer is exempt from assessment, contract or certification.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者), e.g. MAH or sponsor
rows.quote: 第十条 数据处理者向境外提供个人信息的，应当按照法律、行政法规的规定履行告知、取得个人单独同意、进行个人信息保护影响评估等义务。
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 = shall, level Mandatory. The duties apply even when Arts. 3-6 exempt the transfer from assessment, contract or certification. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement says nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 10 A data handler that provides personal information abroad shall, in accordance with laws and administrative regulations, perform obligations such as informing individuals, obtaining the individual's separate consent and carrying out a personal information protection impact assessment.

f.title: Protect outbound data with technical and other necessary measures
f.statement: A data handler providing data abroad shall comply with laws and regulations, perform its data security protection obligations and take technical and other necessary measures to safeguard the security of the outbound data.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety system configuration

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者), e.g. MAH or sponsor
rows.quote: 第十一条 数据处理者向境外提供数据的，应当遵守法律、法规的规定，履行数据安全保护义务，采取技术措施和其他必要措施，保障数据出境安全。
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 = shall, level Mandatory. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote.
rows.quote_en: Article 11 A data handler that provides data abroad shall comply with laws and regulations, perform data security protection obligations and take technical measures and other necessary measures to safeguard the security of cross-border data.

f.title: Take remedial measures and report data security incidents promptly to the cyberspace authority
f.statement: Where a data security incident occurs or may occur in connection with data provided abroad, the data handler shall take remedial measures and report in a timely manner to the cyberspace authority at provincial level or above and to other relevant competent authorities.
f.applicability: China; 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 (Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows), CAC Order No. 16 of 22 March 2024. Binds data handlers (数据处理者), including MAHs, sponsors and PV service providers that send personal information (e.g. ICSR and safety-database data, which include health data = sensitive personal information under PIPL) from mainland China to a global safety database or partner abroad.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Data handler (数据处理者), e.g. MAH or sponsor
rows.deadline: In a timely manner (及时); no fixed period stated
rows.quote: 发生或者可能发生数据安全事件的，应当采取补救措施，及时向省级以上网信部门和其他有关主管部门报告。
rows.review_note: Review: 应当 = shall, level Mandatory; 及时 (in a timely manner) has no number, so no deadline_rule. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Double-check: quote is the second sentence of Art. 11 whose subject (the data handler providing data abroad) is in the first sentence (row 0010).
rows.quote_en: Where a data security incident occurs or may occur, it shall take remedial measures and report in a timely manner to the cyberspace authorities at provincial level or above and other relevant competent authorities.

dates.title: CAC Provisions on Promoting and Regulating Cross-Border Data Flows: take effect on promulgation
dates.scope: All data handlers providing data from mainland China abroad
dates.quote:
现予公布，自公布之日起施行。
 国家互联网信息办公室主任 庄荣文
 2024年3月22日
dates.quote_en: are hereby promulgated and take effect from the date of promulgation. Zhuang Rongwen, Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China, 22 March 2024
dates.timing_note: Order No. 16 states the Provisions take effect on the date of promulgation (also Art. 14), and is dated 22 March 2024. Adopted at the CAC office meeting of 28 November 2023 (not the effective date).
